about: Every location tried for the pMek measurements of Fritsche-Guenther et al. 2011 (doi 10.1038/msb.2011.27, PMC3130559), with what came back, in order. Accessed 2026-10-06. All reads are host reads of official sources (NCBI PMC Cloud open-data bucket, Europe PMC), not spans issued by the VCRP server; the VCRP spans the earlier records cite (lit-*) are listed separately. No search queries were used: each location was fetched directly. The paper is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; the files themselves are not committed here, only identifiers, checksums and the values extract.py copies with their line numbers.
